sections.content:
The RIGHT key moved the endpoint. Looking at the top bar nodes:
- Before: S at (19,25), b at (19,23), g at (19,27)
- After: S at (19,27), b at (19,29), g at (19,31)
So the endpoint (blue/sky-blue pair) moved 2 pixels to the right. The gray connector also shifted.
Let me track the endpoint position more carefully. The endpoint seems to be the blue (b) and sky-blue (S) pair. Initially it was at col 23-25, now it's at col 27-29.
Let me try to understand the full range of movement and what the goal might be. The purple panel has 4 dots at edge centers of a 3x3 grid. Maybe the endpoint needs to be positioned at a specific location that corresponds to one of those dots.
Let me try pressing RIGHT several more times to see the full range, and also try LEFT to go back.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Track endpoint position as we move RIGHT
# Current endpoint is at col 27-29
# Let me move RIGHT several times and track position

for i in range(5):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    endpoint_col = None
    for n in seg:
        if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 8:
            boundary = n['boundary']
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            endpoint_col = min_c
            break
    print(f"RIGHT #{i+1}: endpoint col={endpoint_col}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
